# MCP Client

## Zendesk’s MCP Client allows you to easily connect your Zendesk instance to external MCP Servers.

### About this connector

OAuth-based connections
Our MCP Client takes care of Dynamic Client Registration, kicking off the OAuth flow, securely storing auth credentials, and securely using OAuth tokens to authenticate tool calls. For MCP Servers that require it, we also provide the ability to manually enter OAuth client details.

Tool discovery
Once connected the server’s MCP tools are discovered and processed to capture the tool names, descriptions, input fields, and (if provided by the server) output fields.

Tool management
Your Admins can select which tools they want to make available to Zendesk AI Agents and Action Flows.

Use tools in Action Flows
Tools are made available as steps to use in Action Flows, easily adding new third-party functionality to event-driven workflows, and AI use cases like Auto Assist, AI Agents, and Custom Agents.
